item.title: A Non-Transformer Language Model Emerges in Rust, Skipping the Standard Stack
item.description: PSSA offers an alternative architecture written entirely from scratch in Rust, trading the ubiquitous transformer paradigm for a specialized design. While it bypasses heavy off-the-shelf dependencies, its actual scaling limits remain unproven against larger production workloads.

item.title: Dynamic Pricing Arrives at the Drive-Thru
item.description: McDonald's adoption of algorithmic surge pricing for fast food reduces human friction at the register while turning every lunch hour into a localized auction. The primary risk is predictable customer alienation under the guise of supply-chain efficiency.
